changelog: 📱 Android Notification Silence & Polish: Eliminated sound/vibrate loops via native Kotlin silent channel guard; restored native OS progress bar and Flow chronometer count-up; fixed ongoing sticky notification (unswipeable)
🎯 Mandatory Task Binding: No focus session (Pomodoro, Countdown, Flow) can start without choosing a task in both Focus view and desktop Timer Popout
✨ Clean UI & Dedicated Session Editor: Removed distracting link/change chips from Day Log and Focus; added compact edit modal in Today's Focus Log and Calendar to adjust duration and start/end times
📅 Google Calendar Side-by-Side Columns: Overlapping tasks cleanly split side-by-side (| Task 1 | Task 2 |) across the full width of the day column

⚡ Focus Sessions & Pauses on Calendar Timeline: Automatically blocks completed focus sessions with duration and pause counts on the calendar timeline, seamlessly updating pre-scheduled tasks without duplication
🔀 Schedule Conflict Alignment Modal: Prompts user when an unscheduled focus session overlaps a planned task with 1-click options: Push forward, Move to Unscheduled Tray, Keep both, or Custom time
⏱️ Uncapped Focus Overtime Tracking: Sessions never freeze at target time; live overtime counter (+MM:SS) tracks true elapsed time (e.g. 50m + 15m = 1h 10m+) with dedicated 'Finish' button
📐 Accurate Duration Drag & 15m Resizing: Dragging from tray or grid previews the exact task duration height (no 1h bug); bottom-edge handles allow 15-minute duration resizing
